import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

import java.text.ParseException;
import java.util.Date;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class LegacyDateHelperTest {

    @Test
    void roundTrip() throws ParseException {
        Date d = LegacyDateHelper.parse("29/02/2024");
        assertEquals("29/02/2024", LegacyDateHelper.format(d));
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsImpossibleDate() {
        assertThrows(ParseException.class, () -> LegacyDateHelper.parse("31/02/2024"));
    }
}
